entry_thesis: EURUSD and AUDUSD are both down on the 5-day and 20-day marks. USDJPY and USDCAD agree higher, but USDJPY's shorter averages are still under the 200-day, and USDCAD's five-day spike sits on a nearly flat twenty-day change. AUDNZD is stretched lower with the 20-day breakdown failed, so that cross stays untouched.
